nonBlockingObservations.disposition: WORDING CORRECTION RECORDED, subject unchanged. LD-OPT-4's rationale is to read: the members are exactly the POSIX named T/A signals defined on every supported target, and minimality is relative to that chosen coverage criterion; they are not the complete observable signal set (Linux real-time and platform-specific signals, and Linux SIGPOLL, end signaled with signal absent). The normative item 23a list, the libc-constant mapping and the absent rule are unchanged, as the review states.
nonBlockingObservations.owner: The lead, as S-OP-2's successor author: the next S-OP-2 successor restates LD-OPT-4's rationale in the corrected words. No other unit is gated on it.

rulings.Q1: Accepted. The two selectable protocols pin semantic-provider as their stage operator, so it is a sound common StageKind source. Operation is open, kind is Rust-specific, and language/span names classify different things. Syntax and host-inventory reuse records remain blocked until their own closed operator members are pinned and registered; they must not be mislabeled semantic-provider.
rulings.Q2: Accepted. The phase arrays are finite, ordered, pinned protocol vocabularies consumed by the host table engine. Both source documents explicitly say NORMATIVE and CLOSED, while retaining historical PROPOSED status labels; their authority here rests on the accepted D2b law and pinned vendored bytes, not the standing string alone. T2O has 16 phases, all in P3T's 22; the overlay adds no phase.
rulings.Q3: Accepted. An explicitly enumerated union of named pinned closed enums remains protocol-enum provenance; it creates no new provenance class. C-2 must compare the exact union and preserve each source binding. A TS2 event may use only an applicable T2O phase or admitted TS2 reason, even though the shared table has Rust-only members.
rulings.Q4: Accepted. D9Signal and its generated Common4D9Signal enum fit generated-contract provenance. The exact generated module output must be pinned when registered, as item 3 requires. Replacing only provider.process.reaped.signal's table with ChildSignal is an appropriate narrow successor; host.signal.received retains the three-member D9 vocabulary.
rulings.Q5: Accepted as the chosen portable registry-literal projection: the 21 POSIX named T/A signals less SIGPOLL give the listed 20 constants common to all four targets. No smaller set satisfies that chosen coverage criterion. Map using the target's pinned libc constants, never copied numeric values. Other terminating signals remain signaled with signal absent. This is not an exhaustive native signal vocabulary or a platform-proven minimum logging requirement; see NBO-1.
rulings.Q6: Accepted. The admitted pre-Analyze singleton and TS2/Rust3 post-Analyze Unavailable enums have exactly the listed eleven-member union. Reason is the admitted payload's reason and is present only for unavailable. Fault kinds and budget dimensions/units belong to their own namespaces and are correctly excluded.
rulings.Q7: Accepted. supervision.child.settled is D3's ordinary registration conforming to the three-segment grammar. Correcting M3-D's prose belongs to its next accepted revision; this S-OP-2 successor has no M3-D parent or override. No cross-law name change is silently bound here.

rootAssessment: Substantive assent to the exact reviewed S-OP-2c r1, a contract successor to S-OP-2 r6 raised by D3a-3's cross-law memo (BLOCKED-TABLES.md; LD-D3A3-2) under LD-D3A-10. Two overrides on the one parent: line 881 replaces only provider.process.reaped.signal's table with ChildSignal; line 894 inserts item 23a after item 23, byte for byte the PROPOSAL passage. Item 23a fixes StageKind (protocol-enum: the two protocols' stage operator, semantic-provider), ProviderState (protocol-enum: P3T's 22 phases, T2O's 16 a subset), Signal (generated-contract: COMMON4 D9Signal, for host.signal.received only), the new ChildSignal (registry-literal: the 20 POSIX named T/A signals defined on every supported target, mapped only by the pinned libc constants, signal absent for any other number) and ProviderReason (protocol-enum: the 11-member union of the admitted Unavailable reasons, present only for unavailable). No kind, class, provenance class, sink, bound, event, level, identity or other field changes. Codex ruled Q1 to Q7 accepted. D3's next code unit registers the four blocked events (with C-2's union checks and the generated module pin for Signal); the in-host syntax and inventory StageKind members stay with their owners; supervision.child.settled stays with M3-D's next revision. No product file, registration or qualification.
